comment: The field names in settings-index.json, as one table both sides answer. Settings writes it (apps/settings/src/lib/search/index.ts), the shell parses it (apps/desktop-shell/src-tauri/src/settings_provider.rs). Each side had its own idea of the shape once, in two languages, and they disagreed in production while both test suites stayed green: the writer moved to message ids, the reader still required prose, serde failed on the missing field and Waypointer's settings search returned nothing behind a warn line. Neither suite could see the other. This is the thing they now both read.
